name: Mangara
description: A wise man from Corondor imprisoned by Kaervek in an Amber Prison.

description_citations.text: "Teferi Akosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek claims he has taken Mangara's power.
timeline.quote: "Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?"

citation.text: Disempower (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion centuries ago by supporting their independence.
timeline.quote: Centuries ago, Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion not by ruling their minds but by supporting their independence.

citation.text: Mind Harness (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara reflects that battle is the greatest forge of civilization.
timeline.quote: "How ironic that the greatest forge of civilization is battle."

citation.text: Prismatic Boon (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara creates a peace agreement between Jamuraa's rival nations and a buffer zone policed by Quirion elves.
timeline.quote: Within a century Mangara's Harmony created a new age of enlightenment.

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Conflict and Mangara's Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara arrives in Jamuraa after meeting Jolrael and Kaervek and brokers peace among the nations, settling the Zhalfir-Femeref border with a buffer zone of Quirion Elves.
timeline.quote: Mangara brokered peace between the rival nations

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek resents the peace and persuades Jolrael that Mangara plans domination, sowing discord.
timeline.quote: he convinced her that Mangara's rule was but a prelude to domination

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek instigates skirmishes, then he and Jolrael ambush Mangara and seal him in an Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed Mangara, sealing him within an Amber Prison

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara, Jolrael and Kaervek meet on the barren rock that was Teferi's Isle and settle in Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: The three mages met on the barren rock that had once been Teferi's Isle.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Coming of Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara's diplomacy produces peace agreements between the rival nations.
timeline.quote: Mangara's gifts for diplomacy and intimidation encouraged peace agreements within a few short years.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Coming of Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek draws the reclusive Jolrael into regional politics and they build covert armies.
timeline.quote: Slowly, as Mangara's rule took shape, Kaervek was able to draw the reclusive Jolrael into the politics of the region.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Serpent in Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek and Jolrael ambush Mangara in the Mwonvuli Delta and imprison him in amber.
timeline.quote: Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed him, capturing him within an Amber Prison that now sits in the throne room of one of Jolrael's palaces.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Serpent in Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek manipulates Jolrael, imprisons Mangara in an Amber Prison and declares war on the three nations.
timeline.quote: After imprisoning Mangara in an Amber Prison , they declared war on the three nations.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Asmira's prayers should have freed Mangara from the amber prison.
timeline.quote: Asmira's prayers alone should have freed Mangara from the amber prison . . .

citation.text: Relic Ward (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.
timeline.quote: but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

citation.text: Natural Order (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy and taints Jamuraa out of spite.
timeline.quote: "Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy, but he taints Jamuraa simply out of spite."

citation.text: Blanket of Night (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara confronts Kaervek's arrogance.
timeline.quote: "Your arrogance amazes me, Kaervek. Did you not know the price you would pay?"

citation.text: Aku Djinn (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Asmira leads Scalebane's elite to free Mangara.
timeline.quote: "With Rashida's blades, my guiding vision and the luck of the blessed, today we will free Mangara!"

citation.text: Scalebane's Elite (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Asmira completes the ritual with her final words, her sacrifice shattering the prison and freeing Mangara.
timeline.quote: Her sacrifice was accompanied by a blinding shaft of light that shattered the prison, freeing Mangara.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Cost of Hope". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara defeats Kaervek and seals him in the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Mangara pinned the mage and sealed him in the Amber Prison.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Cost of Hope". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara rebuilds Zhalfir and Femeref after Kaervek's fall.
timeline.quote: Mangara rebuilt Zhalfir and Femeref, aided by the new trust between the two countries.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay's crew joins Asmira and Rashida Scalebane to free Mangara.
timeline.quote: Together, they freed Mangara

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.
timeline.quote: the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life

citation.text: Natural Order (Eternal Masters, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara of Corondor says he has been brought to a place he cannot leave and, though free of the amber, remains in prison.
timeline.quote: "I have been brought to this place and I cannot leave.

citation.text: Mangara of Corondor (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi sends visions to Jamuraa, and Asmira leads the expedition to recover the imprisoned Mangara.
timeline.quote: She led the expedition to recover Mangara, whom Kaervek had imprisoned in an Amber Prison , from the Mwonvuli .

citation.text: "Asmira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Purraj of Urborg slays Asmira while she frees Mangara; she is named the Holy Avenger posthumously.
timeline.quote: She was given the posthumous title of Holy Avenger for her brave sacrifice.

citation.text: "Asmira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hakim is entrusted to represent Suq'Ata in the peace talks Mangara organized.
timeline.quote: Hakim was entrusted by the rulers of Suq'Ata to represent his country

citation.text: "Hakim Loreweaver", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hakim meets Asmira, Rashida and Jabari near Ki'pamu; Asmira explains they must rescue Mangara.
timeline.quote: destiny was driving them to rescue Mangara

citation.text: "Hakim Loreweaver", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's experiments phase his isle out of the present; Jolrael meets Mangara and Kaervek there.
timeline.quote: everything on Teferi's Isle was phased out of the present

citation.text: "Jolrael", section "Mirage wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Manipulated by Kaervek, Jolrael declares war on Mangara, then realizes the truth and attacks Kaervek at sea.
timeline.quote: She rebelled and attacked Kaervek while they were sailing in the Kukemssa Sea to Teferi's Isle

citation.text: "Jolrael", section "Mirage wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Asmira, Rashida Scalebane, Sidar Jabari and Hakim Loreweaver meet in Ki'pamu to start the rescue of Mangara.
timeline.quote: Here the prophet Asmira

citation.text: "Ki'pamu", section "Mirage Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara researches Teferi's Isle and joins Kaervek and Jolrael.
timeline.quote: he joined the two other mages that had been attracted by the event

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara's diplomacy resolves tensions among Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata and he gains control of all three, bringing Mangara's Harmony.
timeline.quote: Mangara brought about a new age of equity, known as Mangara's Harmony

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek twists Mangara's peacemaking into signs of an army, ensnaring Jolrael.
timeline.quote: Kaervek's machinations ensnared Jolrael

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek and Jolrael trap Mangara in the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: ultimately trapped him in the Amber Prison

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Asmira and Rashida free Mangara, who with Quirion and Mundungu allies traps Kaervek in the Prison.
timeline.quote: Mangara was able to turn the tide and trap Kaervek in the Prison

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara is brought to post-apocalyptic Dominaria through the time rifts.
timeline.quote: Mangara was one of the individuals brought to post-apocalyptic Dominaria through the time rifts

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Purraj supervises the invasion of Femeref and Zhalfir and guards the Amber Prison holding Mangara.
timeline.quote: was a guardian of the Amber Prison

citation.text: "Purraj", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Purraj, sole survivor, delivers lethal blows to Asmira, who still completes the ritual; the prison shatters and Mangara is freed.
timeline.quote: Purraj was the sole survivor and leapt at Asmira, delivering lethal blows.

citation.text: "Purraj", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Quirion ally with Mangara during the Mirage War.
timeline.quote: The Quirion allied themselves with Mangara during the Mirage War

citation.text: "Quirion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rashida leads her army against Kaervek and joins an expedition that recovers Mangara with the Dragon Mask.
timeline.quote: joined an expedition to recover Mangara

citation.text: "Rashida Scalebane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
